Examples:
  nyx recon export -e example.com --json
  nyx recon export -e example.com --current --kind finding --output findings.jsonl --json

export writes one JSON object per line to stdout (or --output) for every record in the engagement,
current or not, and for its inputs and exclusions. It reads a snapshot of the state database, takes no
lock, so it works while a run is in progress, writes nothing to the engagement and makes no network
requests. API keys are never in it.

Usage:
  nyx recon export -e <engagement> [flags]

Flags:
  -e, --engagement string   Engagement name (required)
      --output string       Write to this file, replacing it atomically, instead of stdout
      --current             Export only records that are current
      --kind stringArray    Export only this kind (repeatable); the kinds are listed below
      --output-dir string   Directory in which engagement directories are created (default ".")
      --config string       Config file (default $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/nyx/config.yaml, else ~/.config/nyx/config.yaml)
  -h, --help                Help for export

Shared flags:
      --debug   Also write diagnostics to stderr: each failed check (recon), each request to the NVD (cve), each address probed (ip --active), and the stack of an unexpected failure
  -J, --json    Print the result as one JSON object on stdout, and any error as one JSON line on stderr
  -q, --quiet   Write only warnings and errors to stderr; recon's summary is still printed

Kinds accepted by --kind: asn, candidate_rank, code_mention, dns_claim, email_posture, excluded, finding, historical_address, hostname, http_port, ip, ip_hostname, ip_owner, netblock, open_port, organisation, origin_check, port_check, provider_range, registration, reported_port, resolution, root, script, script_parsed, sensitive_hit, server_address, shodan_netblock, storage, storage_account, storage_object, storage_ref, takeover_http, third_party, unresolved, url, web_identifier, web_posture, web_service, wildcard, input, exclusion
Exit codes: 0 success, 1 system error, 2 usage error, 3 not found, 7 partial result, 130/143/129 interrupted (SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGHUP)
